There once was Elise, a vibrant and ambitious young lass with a big dream — becoming filthy rich. Alas, the stars didn’t seem to reserve much fortune for our protagonist. Elise, who came from humble beginnings, had no choice but to spend her days assisting her fellow neighbours with menial tasks to make a living.
  
One day, Elise discovers a pair of beautiful, shiny red shoes buried in her backyard — what a surprise! Bewitched, she embarks on a fearful journey that draws her ever closer into the heart of the mysterious Woods.
  
Will Elise risk it all for the sake of a dream come true, or settle for her humble day-to-day life? The ending of this tale is yours to write…
       
 Little Goody Two Shoes is a horror narrative adventure game, set in a hand-painted fairy tale environment. There are 10 possible endings to fit your choices and actions in the game.
  
But there’s more than meets the eye here, as you must also manage multiple aspects of Elise’s life in the village to stay alive. Remember, all decisions matter in this story!
  
During the day, you will need to strengthen Elise’s bonds with her fellow villagers and work to make a living by playing fun minigames.
  
But once the moon rises, make sure to keep Elise fed, healthy and sane in the multiple encounters with deadly foes as she makes her way further into the Woods.     
        
     
Kieferberg is a small and devout village, which means Elise will need to carefully navigate her relationships with the villagers to avoid arousing suspicion of witchcraft and be left to die in the Woods as punishment. 
    
At night, Elise can roam around the Woodlands, a mystical and phantasmagorical  realm where enigmas and deadly enemies await as she tries to uncover its secrets.
    
Through a limited day and night cycle Elise will need to carefully manage her needs if she wants to stay alive to finish her tale.
    
Get struck by Cupid’s arrow and fall in love with the charming bachelorettes of Kieferberg. In this all-female cast of romanceable characters, unlock dreamy date scenes and storylines for each of them.

title: Proverbs
description:
🧩 Proverbs is  digital cross-stitch. A meditative game about completing a single  enormous  54,000+ piece grid puzzle. 
  
  💣 If you know how to play minesweeper, you already know how to play a Mega Mosaic! The numbered clues (0-9) indicate how many light tiles must be placed within 1 square of the clue. 
  
🖼️ Unravel the mysteries of Peter Bruegel the Elder's enigmatic painting  Netherlandish Proverbs. Piece together over 100 illustrations of 16th century dutch proverbs and idioms, many of which will still be familiar today. 
  
🎶 Whether you're engrossed in your favourite podcasts or listening to your favourite tunes, Mega Mosaic: Proverbs serves as the perfect backdrop to enhance your experience. Or choose from the soothing built-in renaissance soundtrack. 
  
  ⏳ Dozens of Hours of Addictive Gameplay: Get ready to lose yourself in hours of simple, calming but addictive puzzle-solving, with over 90 achievements to collect!

  💣 Si sabes cómo jugar al Buscaminas, ¡ya sabes cómo jugar a un Mega Mosaic ! Las pistas numeradas (0-9) indican cuántas baldosas iluminadas deben colocarse dentro de 1 cuadrado de la pista.

💣 Si vous savez jouer à Démineur, vous savez déjà comment jouer à un Mega Mosaic ! Les indices numérotés (0-9) indiquent combien de tuiles lumineuses doivent être placées à une distance d'une case de l'indice.

🎶 Que vous soyez absorbé par vos podcasts préférés ou écoutiez vos morceaux favoris, Mega Mosaic: Proverbs est le parfait fond sonore pour enrichir votre expérience. Ou choisissez parmi les bandes-son intégrées lo-fi ou renaissance apaisantes.
  
⏳ Des dizaines d'heures de jeu addictif : préparez-vous à vous perdre dans des heures de résolution de puzzles simples, apaisants mais addictifs, avec plus de 90 succès à débloquer !

💣 Wenn du Minesweeper kennst, weißt du schon, wie man ein Mega Mosaic spielt! Die nummerierten Hinweise (0-9) geben an, wie viele helle Kacheln innerhalb von einem Feld um den Hinweis platziert werden müssen.
 
 🖼️ Entschlüssele die Geheimnisse von Pieter Bruegel des Älteren's rätselhafter Malerei Niederländische Sprichwörter. Setze über 100 Illustrationen von niederländischen Sprichwörtern und Redewendungen aus dem 16. Jahrhundert zusammen, von denen viele noch heute bekannt sind.
  
🎶 Ob du dich in deine Lieblingspodcasts vertiefst oder deine Lieblingsmusik hörst,  Mega Mosaic: Proverbs dient als perfekte Kulisse, um dein Erlebnis zu verbessern. Oder wähle zwischen den beruhigenden eingebauten Lo-Fi- oder Renaissance-Soundtracks.

💣 Se sai giocare a Campo Minato, sai già come giocare a un Mega Mosaic ! Gli indizi numerati (0-9) indicano quante tessere luminose devono essere posizionate entro 1 casella dall'indizio.

title: What Remains of Edith Finch
description:
What Remains of Edith Finch is a collection of short stories about a cursed family in Washington State.

Each story offers a chance to experience the life of a different family member with stories ranging from the early 1900s to the present day. The gameplay and tone of the stories are as varied as the family members themselves. The only constants are that each is played from a first-person perspective and that each story ends with that family member's death. It's a game about what it feels like to be humbled and astonished by the vast and unknowable world around us.

You'll follow Edith Finch as she explores the history of her family and tries to figure out why she's the last Finch left alive.

What Remains of Edith Finch  ist eine Sammlung mysteriöser Erzählungen über eine Familie im Bundesstaat Washington.
 
 Du spielst Edith und erkundest das gigantische Haus der Finches auf Suche nach Hinweisen, die dir die Vergangenheit deiner Familie offenbaren und die Frage beantworten, warum du die einzige noch lebende Finch bist. Mit jeder Story, die du enthüllst, erlebst du das Leben eines weiteren Familienmitgliedes am Tage seines Todes und damit Geschichten aus ferner Vergangenheit bis in die Gegenwart.
 
 Gameplay und Handlung der Geschichten sind so unterschiedlich wie die Finches selbst. Was sie jedoch alle gemeinsam haben, ist die Ich-Perspektive und die Art und Weise, wie sie enden … mit dem Tod des jeweiligen Familienmitglieds.
 
 Letztlich ist es ein Spiel, das uns die Demut und das Erstaunen über die unermessliche und unbegreifliche Welt um uns herum erfahren lässt. 
 
 Entwickelt von Giant Sparrow, dem Team hinter dem Ego-Malspiel  The Unfinished Swan  ( Der unvollendete Schwan ).

Winner of Best Game at the 2018 BAFTA Game Awards, as well as Best Narrative awards at the GDC 2018 Choice Awards, 2018 SXSW Gaming Awards, and The Game Awards 2017,  What Remains of Edith Finch  is a collection of strange tales about a family in Washington state.
 
 As Edith, you’ll explore the colossal Finch house, searching for stories as she explores her family history and tries to figure out why she's the last one in her family left alive. Each story you find lets you experience the life of a new family member on the day of their death, with stories ranging from the distant past to the present day.
 
 The gameplay and tone of the stories are as varied as the Finches themselves. The only constants are that each is played from a first-person perspective and that each story ends with that family member's death.
 
 Ultimately, it's a game about what it feels like to be humbled and astonished by the vast and unknowable world around us.
 
 Created by Giant Sparrow, the team behind the first-person painting game  The Unfinished Swan .

 Encarnando a Edith, explorarás la gigantesca casa de los Finch en busca de historias, mientras ella ahonda en la historia familiar y trata de averiguar por qué es el último integrante de la familia que sigue con vida. Cada historia que vayas encontrando te permitirá experimentar la vida de un nuevo miembro de la familia en el día de su muerte, con historias ambientadas tanto en un pasado lejano como en la actualidad.
 
 La mecánica del juego y el tono de las historias son tan variados como los miembros de la familia Finch. La única constante es que todas las historias se juegan desde una perspectiva en primera persona y que todas terminan con la muerte de ese pariente.
 
 En definitiva, el juego trata sobre el sentimiento de sorpresa e inquietud ante el vasto y desconocido mundo que nos rodea.
 
 Creado por Giant Sparrow, el equipo detrás del juego de pintura en primera persona  The Unfinished Swan .

 Le style de jeu et la tonalité de ces histoires sont aussi variés que le sont les Finch. Leur seul point commun est qu’elles se jouent toutes en vue subjective et se terminent toujours par la mort de ce membre de la famille.

 Créé par Giant Sparrow, l’équipe à l’origine du jeu de peinture en vue subjective  The Unfinished Swan .

 Nei panni di Edith, perlustrerai l'imponente casa dei Finch, in cerca di aneddoti mentre lei esplora la sua storia familiare e cerca di capire il motivo per cui è l'ultima superstite del suo albero genealogico. title: Danganronpa: Trigger Happy Havoc
description:
In "Danganronpa" you'll dive into a series of class trials and expose the lies and contradictions of your classmates in order to find out who's behind each grisly murder. In each trial, you'll have to use the evidence and testimony collected during your investigation to literally shoot down your opponent's assertions. By combining logic and motion, "Danganronpa" offers an exciting and unprecedented gaming experience.

Hope's Peak Academy is a government-funded private high school recognized all across the nation as the cradle of hope and prosperity, providing a complete education for "ultimate" students of all stripes.

Thanks to a national lottery, one extremely lucky but otherwise ordinary student—Makoto Naegi—has been chosen to attend this prestigious institution.

But when Makoto arrives for his first day of class, he suddenly falls unconscious, and when he wakes up he finds himself in a classroom within the school—with the windows barred and the doors locked. As he explores the abandoned, dirty halls, it becomes clear that something is very wrong. He and his new classmates make their way to the gymnasium, where a demented robotic bear, calling himself Monokuma and claiming to be the school's headmaster, makes a declaration: "You're all going to be living here from now on. If you want to go free, your only choice...is murder."

And so...fifteen high school students gathered from across the country have been imprisoned. Their strength, their commitment, their very humanity will be tested time and time again. Why must they clash in these class trials? Who's the mastermind behind it all? And what is this shadowy figure really after? The battle against the looming, invisible enemy known only as despair is about to begin...

title: WITCH ON THE HOLY NIGHT
description:
Product Description 
 TYPE-MOON, known for the wildly popular mobile game "Fate/Grand Order" and the epic visual novel "Tsukihime," is releasing a remaster of the 2012 hit "Witch on the Holy Night. Experience a coming of age story set in the vibrant, bustling 1980s, which follows an innocent young man and two young "witches." Updates added since the original release include long-awaited fully voiced characters as well as visuals remastered in full HD, bringing the experience to life with unparalleled quality and fidelity. Masterful manipulation of visual elements imbues combat scenes with nail-biting tension, but also breathes life into the characters' everyday activities. Animated graphical elements bring an entirely new level of depth to the reading experience as well!
 
  STORY 
 In the mansion on the hill, there lived two witches...
 
 It is the late 1980s—the twilight of an era of beauty and vigor.
 A boy moves to the city, barely missing two witches living in modern times.
 
 The boy leads a completely ordinary life.
 She carries herself with gallant pride.
 The girl lives a sleepy, hidden life.
 
 Each walks a starlit path.
 One would never expect their paths to cross.
 The story of how these three disparate people came together is soon to be told.

Product Description 
 TYPE-MOON, known for the wildly popular mobile game "Fate/Grand Order" and the epic visual novel "Tsukihime," is releasing a remaster of the 2012 hit "Witch on the Holy Night. Experience a coming of age story set in the vibrant, bustling 1980s, which follows an innocent young man and two young "witches." Updates added since the original release include long-awaited fully voiced characters as well as visuals remastered in full HD, bringing the experience to life with unparalleled quality and fidelity. Masterful manipulation of visual elements imbues combat scenes with nail-biting tension, but also breathes life into the characters' everyday activities. Animated graphical elements bring an entirely new level of depth to the reading experience as well!
 
  STORY 
 In the mansion on the hill, there lived two witches...
 
 It is the late 1980s—the twilight of an era of beauty and vigor.
 A boy moves to the city, barely missing two witches living in modern times.
 
 The boy leads a completely ordinary life.
 She carries herself with gallant pride.
 The girl lives a sleepy, hidden life.
 
 Each walks a starlit path.
 One would never expect their paths to cross.
 The story of how these three disparate people came together is soon to be told.

Description du produit 
 TYPE-MOON, connu pour la célèbre appli de jeu « Fate/Grand Order » et pour le roman visuel épique « Tsukihime », publie le roman visuel « Witch on the Holy Night », sorti une première fois en 2012 en version PC, sur Steam.
 Découvrez l’histoire d’un jeune adulte, située dans les années 80 dynamiques et trépidantes, à la suite d’un jeune homme innocent et deux jeunes « sorcières ».
 Les mises à jour ajoutées depuis la version pour PC comportent des personnages entièrement doublés, ce que les fans attendaient depuis longtemps, ainsi que des visuels remastérisés en Full HD, ce qui rend l’expérience vivante grâce à une qualité d’image sans précédent.
 Les divers éléments visuels nouveaux ne se cantonnent pas à saturer de tension les scènes de combat, ils donnent également vie aux activités quotidiennes des personnages avec des mouvements rappelant un film d’animation et ils rendent les dialogues encore plus captivants.
 
  INTRIGUE Deux sorcières résident dans un manoir au sommet d’une colline.
 
 C’est la fin des années 80, années déclinantes d’une époque dynamique et trépidante.
 Un garçon arrive en ville et rencontre deux sorcières vivant à l’époque présente.
 
 Le garçon mène une vie normale.
 Une des filles est fière et digne.
 L’autre vit cachée, comme en léthargie.
 
 Trois étoiles sur une orbite parallèle, condamnées à ne jamais se rencontrer.
 La façon dont ces trois personnages très différents finissent par vivre ensemble sous un même toit sera bientôt révélée...

Produktbeschreibung 
 TYPE-MOON, bekannt für die populäre Game-App „Fate/Grand Order“ und die epische Visual Novel „Tsukihime“, bringen eine weiteres ihrer Werke, „Witch on the Holy Night“, das 2012 erstmals auf dem PC erschienen ist, nun auch auf die Steam.
 Erlebe eine Young-Adult-Story um einen unschuldigen jungen Mann und zwei junge „Hexen“ in den pulsierenden, aufregenden 1980er Jahren.
 Seit der PC-Veröffentlichung haben die Charaktere eine volle Sprachausgabe bekommen, auf die Fans lange gewartet haben, und die Grafik wurde in Full-HD remastered, um die Geschichte mit unvergleichlicher Bildqualität zum Leben zu erwecken.
 Die zahlreichen neuen visuellen Elemente verleihen nicht nur den Kampfszenen mehr Spannung, sondern hauchen auch dem Alltag der Charaktere neues Leben ein, mit Bewegungen, die den Bildern ein Feeling von Animationsfilmen geben und dich noch tiefer in den Text eintauchen lassen.
 
  STORY 
 In einem Herrenhaus auf einem Hügel leben zwei Hexen.
 
 Es sind die späten 1980er Jahre, eine pulsierende, aufregende Ära neigt sich dem Ende zu.
 Ein junger Mann kommt in die Stadt und findet heraus, dass hier zwei Hexen in der Moderne leben.
 
 Der junge Mann führt eigentlich ein ganz normales Leben.
 Eines der Mädchen ist stolz und anmutig.
 Das andere lebt zurückgezogen, fast wie im Dornröschenschlaf.
 
 Drei Sterne auf ihren eigenen Umlaufbahnen, in ihren eigenen Welten.
 Die Geschichte, wie diese drei so unterschiedlichen Charaktere sich eines Tages unter einem Dach wiederfinden, diese Story wird bald erzählt werden...

Produktbeskrivelse 
 TYPE-MOON, kendt for den populære spil-app ”Fate/Grand Order” og den episke visuelle roman ”Tsukihime”, udgiver den visuelle roman ”Witch on the Holy Night”, der første gang blev lanceret til pc i 2012, på Steam.
 Oplev en ung voksenfortælling, der foregår i de livlige og travle 1980ʼere, som følger en uskyldig ung mand og to unge ”hekse”.
 Opdateringer tilføjet siden pc-versionen omfatter både stemmer til alle personer, hvilket fans har ventet længe på, og forbedrede visuelle effekter i fuld HD, der vækker oplevelsen til live med uovertruffen billedkvalitet.
 Forskellige nye visuelle elementer præger ikke alene kampscenerne med spænding, men puster også liv i personernes hverdagsaktiviteter med bevægelser, der giver en følelse af animation og gør teksten endnu mere dybt opslugende.
 
  HANDLING 
 To hekse opholder sig på en herregård på toppen af en bakke.
 
 Det er sidst i 1980ʼerne, tusmørkeårene i en livlig og travl æra.
 En dreng kommer til byen kun for at støde på to hekse, der lever i dag.
 
 Drengen lever et normalt liv.
 En af pigerne er stolt og værdig.
 Den anden lever i skjul som var hun i dvale.
 
 Tre stjerner i parallelt kredsløb med den skæbne aldrig at mødes.
 Historien om, hvordan disse tre helt forskellige personer kommer til at leve under samme tag, afsløres snart...

Descrizione prodotto 
 TYPE-MOON, conosciuto per la popolare app di gioco “Fate/Grand Order” e l’epica visual novel “Tsukihime”, sta per rilasciare la visual novel “Witch on the Holy Night”, pubblicata per la prima volta per PC nel 2012, sulla Steam.
 La storia, ambientata nei dinamici e stimolanti anni 80, è quella di giovani adulti e racconta di un ragazzo innocente e di due giovani “streghe”.
 Gli aggiornamenti rispetto alla versione per PC comprendono i personaggi a tutto tondo che i fan hanno atteso da molto tempo, nonché una grafica rimasterizzata in full HD, che anima l’esperienza con una qualità dell’immagine impareggiabile.
 I nuovi e svariati elementi visivi non soltanto arricchiscono di tensione le scene di battaglia, ma infondono anche vita alle attività quotidiane dei personaggi, con movimenti che apportano un senso di animazione e rendono il testo ancora più profondamente coinvolgente.
 
  STORIA 
 Due streghe abitano in una dimora sulla cima di una collina.
 
 Sono gli ultimi anni 80, gli anni del crepuscolo di un'epoca dinamica e stimolante.
 Un ragazzo arriva in città e finisce per incontrare due streghe che vivono nei tempi attuali.
 
 Il ragazzo conduce una vita normale.
 Una delle ragazze è orgogliosa e ricca di dignità.
 L’altra vive nascosta, come se immersa nel torpore.
 
 Tre stelle che si trovano su orbite parallele, destinate a non incontrarsi mai.
 La storia di come questi tre personaggi completamente diversi arrivano a vivere sotto lo stesso tetto sarà presto rivelata...

Set in 1980s Japan, Witch on the Holy Night tells the story of fan-favorite Type-Moon character Aoko Aozaki as she attempts to navigate the complex world of magecraft while also dealing with the everyday struggles of life as a high school student! Players will experience the thrilling origin story of this much-beloved character, penned by Kinoko Nasu, famed creator of the Fate series, himself.

---Two witches live in a mansion on a hill---

The late 1980s. The twilight of an era full of splendor and vitality.
A young boy comes down to the city and crosses paths with two witches living in the modern age.

The boy has lived a very natural life.
She lives a dignified life with her breasts outstretched.
The girl lives in hiding as if she were asleep.

The three of them are three different star-crossed people.
They are not supposed to cross each other.
The three of them are different in every way, and their shared life together will not begin until a little while later...

■作品概要 
 曾带来游戏App《Fate/Grand Order》和长篇奇幻视觉小说《月姬》的「TYPE-MOON」
 于2012年发售的视觉小说《魔法使之夜》将于Steam登场。
 本作是以繁华且活力四射的1980年代为舞台，
 由未经世事的少年与被称为“魔女”的两位少女交织而成的青年向小说。
 相较于PC原版，登陆Steam平台的本作，不仅实现了粉丝期待已久的全语音化，
 还对画面与影像素材进行了全高清HD化升级，呈现出更加丰富多彩的视觉效果。
 本作中巧用各类图像素材，展现出紧张感十足的战斗场景。
 同时日常生活的场景也不在话下，各类场景富有动感栩栩如生，仿佛是一部精美的动画巨作。
 进一步加深玩家在本作中的沉浸体验。
 
  ■STORY 
 ―――在那坡道尽头的古宅之中，有两位魔女闲居于此―――
 
 时值1980年代后期，这个繁华又充满活力的时代正值黄昏。
 来到城市的少年，与生活在现代社会的两位魔女萍水相逢。
 
 少年的日常起居与一般人别无二致，
 而她总是昂首挺胸盛气凛然，
 少女则是仿佛熟睡一般隐居于此。
 形色各异的三人相逢于此，
 他们的命运就此开始交织。
 截然不同的三人，他们共同生活的故事即将开幕——―

■作品簡介 
 操刀過知名遊戲《Fate/Grand Order》以及長篇傳奇視覺小說《月姬》的「TYPE-MOON」，
 為您將2012年發行的視覺小說《魔法使之夜》，呈現在Steam的平台。
 本作品是一部以華麗且充滿活力的1980年代為舞台，
 由一位涉世未深的少年及兩名被稱為「魔女」的少女所共同編織出的青春物語。
 依據PC版的內容加以更新，除加上了所有粉絲引頸期盼的全語音，
 遊戲中的所有圖片以及影像素材皆經Full HD處理，呈現出其他遊戲無法比擬的精彩畫面。
 遊戲內的演出巧妙地活用各種圖像素材，不僅是緊張刺激的戰鬥場面，
 就連日常生活場景也發揮其效，經常能看見猶如動畫般的動作，
 讓玩家們更容易沉浸於文字的世界中。
 
  ■STORY 
 ―――坡道上的宅邸裡，住著兩位魔女―――
 
 1980年後半。這充滿活力且紙醉金迷的時代，某個黃昏時分。
 一位來到大都會的少年，與兩位活在現代的魔女擦肩而過。
 
 少年原在極度自然的環境下生活，
 其中一位少女性格驕傲凜然，
 另一位則如沉眠般的隱居著。
 原本三人的命運理應毫無交集，
 會兜在一起實屬離奇。
 而為何這三個原本毫無交集的人會開始同居生活呢？這又是另外一個故事了―――

■作品概要 
 ゲームアプリ『Fate/Grand Order』、長編伝奇ビジュアルノベル『月姫』を手がける
 「TYPE-MOON」が、2012年に発売したビジュアルノベル
 『魔法使いの夜』をSteam向けに送り出す。
 本作は、華やかさと活力に満ちた1980年代を舞台として、
 世間知らずの少年と"魔女"と称される2人の少女とが織りなす
 ジュブナイルストーリーとなっている。
 PC版からのアップデート内容として、ファン待望のフルボイス化に加えて、
 画像や映像素材のフルHD化を行うことで、他に類を見ない豊かな映像を実現。
 各種画像素材を巧みに使用した演出が、緊張感のあるバトルシーンはもちろん、
 日常のシーンにも生かされており、時にアニメーションを思わせる動きは、
 ユーザーのテキストへの没入感をさらに深めている。
 
  ■STORY 
 ―――坂の上のお屋敷には、二人の魔女が住んでいる―――
 
 1980年代後半。華やかさと活力に満ちた時代の黄昏時。
 都会におりてきた少年は、現代に生きる二人の魔女とすれ違う。
 
 少年はごく自然に暮らしてきて、
 彼女は凛々しく胸を張って、
 少女は眠るように隠れ住んで。
 
 三者三様の星の巡り。
 交わることなんてもってのほか。
 何もかも違う三人の共同生活が始まるのは、あと、もうちょっと先の話―――

title: Red Dead Redemption 2
description:
Red Dead Redemption 2 is the epic tale of outlaw Arthur Morgan and the infamous Van der Linde gang, on the run across America at the dawn of the modern age.

America, 1899. The end of the wild west era has begun as lawmen hunt down the last remaining outlaw gangs. Those who will not surrender or succumb are killed.

After a robbery goes badly wrong in the western town of Blackwater, Arthur Morgan and the Van der Linde gang are forced to flee. With federal agents and the best bounty hunters in the nation massing on their heels, the gang must rob, steal and fight their way across the rugged heartland of America in order to survive. As deepening internal divisions threaten to tear the gang apart, Arthur must make a choice between his own ideals and loyalty to the gang who raised him.

美国，1899 年。当警察开始打击残余亡命之徒的帮派时，蛮荒的西部时代迎来了最后的黄昏。不愿投降或是屈服的人，只有死路一条。

亚瑟·摩根和范德林德帮众在黑水镇的一次抢劫行动遭遇了始料不及的意外，他们不得不逃离这个西部小镇。联邦侦探和全国顶尖的赏金猎人在他们的身后穷追不舍，亚瑟一行人必须在广袤蛮荒的美国腹地上四处劫掠、挣扎求生。而帮派内部的矛盾分化日渐加深，摆在亚瑟面前的将是他无法避免的抉择：究竟是选择自己的理想，还是选择效忠于抚养了自己的帮派。

Red Dead Redemption 2 由 Grand Theft Auto V 和 Red Dead Redemption 的原班人马精心打造，在文明初开的时代背景下，谱写了美国腹地上的一部快意恩仇史。即将于 2018 年 10 月 26 日登陆 PlayStation 4 和 Xbox One 平台，敬请期待。

Ultimate Edition   
 The Red Dead Redemption 2:  Ultimate Edition delivers all of the Story Mode content from the Special Edition plus additional content for online including Bonus Outfits for your online Character, Rank Bonuses, Black Chestnut Thoroughbred and free access to the Survivor Camp Theme.
 
 Plus get free access to Additional Weapons in online.
 
  About the Game America, 1899.
 
 Arthur Morgan and the Van der Linde gang are outlaws on the run. With federal agents and the best bounty hunters in the nation massing on their heels, the gang must rob, steal and fight their way across the rugged heartland of America in order to survive. As deepening internal divisions threaten to tear the gang apart, Arthur must make a choice between his own ideals and loyalty to the gang who raised him.
 
 Now featuring additional Story Mode content and a fully-featured Photo Mode, Red Dead Redemption 2 also includes free access to the shared living world of Red Dead Online, where players take on an array of roles to carve their own unique path on the frontier as they track wanted criminals as a Bounty Hunter, create a business as a Trader, unearth exotic treasures as a Collector or run an underground distillery as a Moonshiner and much more.
 
 With all new graphical and technical enhancements for deeper immersion, Red Dead Redemption 2 for PC takes full advantage of the power of the PC to bring every corner of this massive, rich and detailed world to life including increased draw distances; higher quality global illumination and ambient occlusion for improved day and night lighting; improved reflections and deeper, higher resolution shadows at all distances; tessellated tree textures and improved grass and fur textures for added realism in every plant and animal.
 
 Red Dead Redemption 2 for PC also offers HDR support, the ability to run high-end display setups with 4K resolution and beyond, multi-monitor configurations, widescreen configurations, faster frame rates and more.

 Erhalte zusätzlich kostenlosen Zugriff auf weitere Waffen im Online-Modus.
 
  Infos zum Spiel Amerika, 1899. 
 
 Arthur Morgan und die Outlaws der Van-der-Linde-Gang sind auf der Flucht. Während Bundesagenten und die besten Kopfgeldjäger des Landes ihnen dicht auf den Fersen sind, muss sich die Gang raubend, stehlend und kämpfend einen Weg durch das erbarmungslose Herz Amerikas bahnen, um zu überleben. Als zunehmende interne Konflikte drohen, die Gang auseinanderzureißen, muss sich Arthur zwischen seinen eigenen Idealen und der Loyalität zu der Gang, mit der er einst aufgewachsen ist, entscheiden.
 
 Red Dead Redemption 2 beinhaltet jetzt zusätzliche Inhalte für den Story-Modus, einen umfangreichen Fotomodus, sowie kostenlosen Zugriff auf die lebendige Welt von Red Dead Online, in der Spieler in eine Vielzahl von Rollen schlüpfen können, um ihren einzigartigen Pfad im Grenzland einzuschlagen, wenn sie als Kopfgeldjäger gefährliche Verbrecher zur Strecke bringen, als Händler ein Unternehmen gründen, als Sammler wertvolle Schätze entdecken oder als Schwarzbrenner eine Destille im Untergrund betreiben und vieles mehr.
 
 Red Dead Redemption 2 für PC bietet komplett neue grafische und technische Verbesserungen, die für eine noch tiefere Immersion sorgen. Es nutzt die Leistungsfähigkeit des PCs voll aus, um jede Ecke dieser riesigen, reichhaltigen und detaillierten Welt zum Leben zu erwecken – mit einer erhöhten Sichtweite, einer qualitativ höheren globalen Beleuchtung sowie Umgebungsverdeckung für eine verbesserte Lichtstimmung bei Tag und Nacht, verbesserten Reflexionen, tieferen, höher aufgelösten Schatten auf alle Entfernungen sowie tessellierten Baumtexturen und verbesserten Gras- und Pelztexturen für noch größeren Realismus bei allen Pflanzen und Tieren.
 
 Red Dead Redemption 2 für PC unterstützt HDR, High-End-Displays mit 4K-Auflösung (und höher), Setups mit mehreren Monitoren, Widescreen-Konfigurationen und ermöglicht höhere Bildwiederholraten und mehr.

brief:
Red Dead Redemption 2 is the epic tale of outlaw Arthur Morgan and the infamous Van der Linde gang, on the run across America at the dawn of the modern age.

America, 1899. The end of the wild west era has begun as lawmen hunt down the last remaining outlaw gangs. Those who will not surrender or succumb are killed.

After a robbery goes badly wrong in the western town of Blackwater, Arthur Morgan and the Van der Linde gang are forced to flee. With federal agents and the best bounty hunters in the nation massing on their heels, the gang must rob, steal and fight their way across the rugged heartland of America in order to survive. As deepening internal divisions threaten to tear the gang apart, Arthur must make a choice between his own ideals and loyalty to the gang who raised him.

The game blends storytelling and gameplay in new ways as players repeatedly jump in and out of the lives of the game’s three lead characters, playing all sides of the game’s interwoven story.

Los Santos: a sprawling sun-soaked metropolis full of self-help gurus, starlets and fading celebrities, once the envy of the Western world, now struggling to stay afloat in an era of economic uncertainty and cheap reality TV.

洛圣都——一个辽阔的阳光之都，充斥着自强不息的大师、明日之星或是光芒不再的昔日名人。它曾是让西方世界羡慕不已的耀眼都会，但在这个经济不稳、廉价电视真人秀大行其道的年代，也只能挣扎求生。

在这样混乱的世道中，有三个性格迥异的罪犯各怀鬼胎，努力追求生存和成功：富兰克林，一名街头混混，为了赚大钱而一心追求真正发达的机会；麦克，有前科的职业罪犯，但退休生活远不如他想象中美好；崔佛，受廉价毒品和大干一票的欲望驱使，是个狂暴的疯子。越来越身不由己的这帮人，只能不顾一切投入一连串大胆而危险的抢劫任务，就算会惹祸上身也在所不惜。

Grand Theft Auto V 是迄今为止规模最大、最有活力且最为多元化的开放世界游戏，以崭新的方式融合了叙事和游玩，让玩家可以切换三个主要角色，经历他们的生活，以不同的角度体验游戏中错综复杂的故事。

此开创性系列的所有经典重头戏都会再度重现，包括令人叹为观止的细节设计，以及 GTA 对现代文化的黑色幽默讽刺，另外还有全新且立志高远的开放世界多人游戏。

title: Divinity: Original Sin II
description:
Divinity: Original Sin II is a single- and multiplayer top-down, party-based role-playing game with pen & paper RPG-like levels of freedom. It features turn-based combat, a strong focus on systematic gameplay and a well-grounded narrative.

The Divine is dead. The Void approaches. And the powers lying dormant within you are soon to awaken. The battle for Divinity has begun. Choose wisely and trust sparingly; darkness lurks within every heart.

title: Project Zomboid
description:
Project Zomboid is the ultimate in zombie survival. Alone or in MP: you loot, build, craft, fight, farm and fish in a struggle to survive. A hardcore RPG skillset, a vast map, a massively customisable sandbox and a cute tutorial raccoon await the unwary. So how will you die?

The Knox Event is used to refer to the zombie outbreak that occurs prior to and throughout the game. The event first takes place around Muldraugh and West Point, Kentucky. The incident is considered to have begun on the 4th of July, 1993, American Day of Independence. Just two days later the military evacuated residences from around the affected area and set up blockades in what is now known as the Knox Evacuation. The affected area is given the name: the Exclusion Zone, with the primary camp being south of Louisville.

開放世界生存恐怖電子遊戲
开放世界生存恐怖电子游戏

Project Zomboid is an open-ended zombie-infested sandbox. It asks one simple question – how will you die? 
 
 In the towns of Muldraugh and West Point, survivors must loot houses, build defences and do their utmost to delay their inevitable death day by day. No help is coming – their continued survival relies on their own cunning, luck and ability to evade a relentless horde. Current Features 
   Hardcore Sandbox Zombie Survival Game with a focus on realistic survival.
   Online multiplayer survival with persistent player run servers. 
   Local 4 player split-screen co-op
   Hundreds of zombies with swarm mechanics and in-depth visual and hearing systems. 
   Full line of sight system and real-time lighting, sound and visibility mechanics. Hide in the shadows, keep quiet and keep the lights off at night, or at least hang sheets over the windows.   
   Vast and growing map (loosely based on a real world location) for you to explore, loot and set up your fortress. Check out Blindcoder’s map project: 
    Vehicles with full physics and deep and realistic gameplay mechanics.
   Use tools and items to craft weapons, barricade and cook. You can even build zombie proof forts by chopping trees, sawing wood and scavenging supplies. 
   Deal with depression, boredom, hunger, thirst and illness while trying to survive. 
   Day turns to night. The electricity falters. Hordes migrate. Winter draws in. Nature gradually starts to take over.
   Farming, fishing, carpentry, cooking, trapping, character customization, skills and perks that develop based on what you do in-game. 
   Proper zombies that don’t run. (Unless you tell them to in the sandbox menu).
   A ton of amazing atmospheric music tracks by the prodigy that is Zach Beever. 
   Imaginative Challenge scenarios and instant action ‘Last Stand’ mode, on top of regular Sandbox and Survival 
   Full, open and powerful Lua modding support. 
   Xbox Controller Gamepad support on Windows. (Other gamepads can be set up manually.)
 
 We’re a small team at the moment, but we’re also committed to providing the following:    planned Features:    
   The return of our PZ Stories mode that also serves as first ever tutorial actively trying to kill you at every turn. Kate and Baldspot return!
   In-depth and varied NPC encounters driven in a persistent world, powered by a metagame system that turns each play-through into your very own zombie survival movie with emergent narrative gameplay.
   Constant expansion of the countryside and cities around Muldraugh and West Point
   Full wilderness survival systems, animals and hunting for food. 
   More items, crafting recipes, weapons and gameplay systems. 
   Steam Workshop and Achievements support  
 For more details on the game follow us on @theindiestone or visit

brief:
Project Zomboid is the ultimate in zombie survival. Alone or in MP: you loot, build, craft, fight, farm and fish in a struggle to survive. A hardcore RPG skillset, a vast map, a massively customisable sandbox and a cute tutorial raccoon await the unwary. So how will you die?

The Knox Event is used to refer to the zombie outbreak that occurs prior to and throughout the game. The event first takes place around Muldraugh and West Point, Kentucky. The incident is considered to have begun on the 4th of July, 1993, American Day of Independence. Just two days later the military evacuated residences from around the affected area and set up blockades in what is now known as the Knox Evacuation. The affected area is given the name: the Exclusion Zone, with the primary camp being south of Louisville.

title: Carto
description:
Carto is a tile placement adventure game where you explore the lands you placed and discover the secrets while exploring. What will happen to the world and the characters when you rearrange the tiles of the map?

Separated from her Granny during a storm, young Carto must use her innate cartography powers to map and manipulate the world around her on her quest to be reunited. As she discovers new “pieces” of the game map, players can rearrange them to shape the levels themselves — unlocking new paths, puzzles, and story moments.

title: Volcano Princess
description:
After the war between humans and demons, you found a baby on the battlefield and became a father. You will Plan time and courses for her, bring her into contact with various roles, and raise her up. The daughter's future and the ending of the volcano country depends on each of your choices.

Spend precious time with your daughter as she grows up!
You were a soldier of great virtue, who found this little girl the night the war ended.Raise your daughter from infancy, through schooling and into adulthood as you accompany her on the path to adulthood.

When you take your daughter out, as well as boating, eating, and amusement, you can also meet all kinds of town residents.
These residents aren't simply passengers in your daughter's life journey, they also have their own lives!
NPC residents have their own stories, and the choices of you and your daughter will affect their lives.
A wholesome and tender bonding experience!
Start with babbling and crawling, slowly learn manners, etiquette, knowledge...carefully arrange everything for her.Let her learn music and painting, or make her proficient in martial arts and fighting. What kind of future will intertwine with dozens of different skill combinations?

If you neglect her, your daughter may go astray.
Volcano Festival celebration! Competition! Adventure!
In the grand Volcano Festival celebration, let your daughter show off her skills in the competition!The secrets of the ancestors lay buried in the dark canyon, waiting for the brave to discover…
A variety of endings!
What kind of person will the daughter become?Will she be outstanding, ordinary, or evil?
Every decision will affect your daughter's future.
She can become anything and pursue all kinds of dreams, everything is up to you.

title: Z.A.T.O. // I Love the World and Everything In It
description:
USSR, 1986.  

When Ira Grachevskaya goes missing in the closed city of Vorkuta-5, not a soul seems to be concerned – except for the quiet outcast Asya Shubina, that is. Uncover the mystery behind Ira’s disappearance, transmit your radio signal to the universe and learn why a bird flies past the window.
  
CHARACTERS  

Meet the cast.
     
• Ira Grachevskaya (Grade 8)

A problem child and a truant, Ira doesn't have the best reputation. Her standoffish demeanor makes her difficult to talk to, especially for someone as meek as you. There is a rumour she's been meeting with an older man.
  
• Marina Kaplan (Grade 9)

Marina's carefree personality makes her quite popular among her classmates. Adults don't seem to like her very much, probably due to poor grades. Despite the girl's outgoing nature, her worldview is rather cynical.
  
• Vadim Garin (Grade 8)

A boy with an unpleasant sense of humour. Likes picking on people weaker than him, namely you. His family has been a little out of it the past few weeks.

• Asya Shubina (Grade 8)

Not worth writing about.
  
GAME INFO  

Z.A.T.O. is a linear visual novel with roughly 7-8 hours of playtime. There are no choices. The ending is predetermined. Sit back and enjoy your time in a town that doesn't exist.
   
DISCLAIMER: the game contains strong language, loud noises and flickering images.

title: Stacklands
description:
Stacklands   is a village builder where you stack cards to collect food, build structures, and fight creatures.
 
 For example, dragging a 'Villager' card on top of a 'Berry Bush' card will spawn 'Berry' cards which the villagers can eat to survive!
 
  
 
   Sell Cards   💰
 You can also sell cards to get coins which you can then use to buy Card Packs. Packs contain multiple cards that you can use to expand your village. Every pack has a focus such as Cooking, Farming or Building.
 
 At the end of every Moon you'll need to feed all your villagers - so make sure you have enough food, or your villagers will starve! 💀
 
   Features   🔥
   🃏 200+ Cards to collect
   💡 60+ Ideas to find
   ✅ 50+ Quests to complete
   📦 13 different Card Packs to buy
   🕒 5-7 hours of playtime  
   Combat   🗡️
 A Villager bumping into an evil creature will engage in an automatic battle. Fight Goblins, Bears, Rats and more! Improve your Villager's combat abilities by giving them weapons or by making them team up against enemies.
 
  
 
   Find Ideas   🧠
 Expand your knowledge by finding Idea Cards. An Idea Card will tell you how to create new cards, for example: stack 2 Wood, 1 Stone and 1 Villager to build a House.

localized_description.text:
《Stacklands》  是一一款村庄建设游戏，你可以在那里堆叠卡牌以收集食物、修建建筑、并与各种生物战斗。
 
 例如，将“村民”卡牌拖至“浆果灌木”顶部将会生成“浆果”卡牌，村民们可以吃这些浆果卡牌来生存！
 
  
 
   出售卡牌   �
 你还可以出售卡牌以获得硬币，然后使用硬币购买卡包。卡包里有多张卡牌，可以用来扩大你的村庄。每个卡包都有一个主题，如烹饪、农业或修建。
 
 在每个月亮年结束时，你需要喂饱所有村民——所以要确保有足够的食物，否则你得村民会挨饿！�
 
   特点   �
   🃏 200+ 张可收集的卡牌
   💡 60+个可找到的主意
   ✅ 80+ 个可完成的任务
   📦 13 个不同的可购买的卡包
   🕒 5-7 小时的游戏时间  
   战斗   �
 村民遇到邪恶生物时会自动加入战斗。与小妖精、熊、老鼠等生物战斗！通过向村民提供武器或者让他们组队，来提高村民的战斗能力！
 
  
 
   找到主意   �
 通过找到主意卡牌来扩展你的知识面。主意卡牌将告诉你如何创造新卡牌，如：堆叠2块木材、1块石头和1个村民来修建房子。

Stacklands  是一款建設村莊的遊戲，藉由堆疊卡牌來收集食物、建造設施，以及與其他生物戰鬥。
 
 舉例來說，拖曳「村民」卡牌到「莓果灌木」卡牌上面就會製造出「莓果」卡牌，可以讓村民食用並存活哦！
 
  
 
   出售卡牌   💰
 你可以出售卡牌獲得金幣，然後再用來購買牌組。牌組裡面有多種卡牌可以用來擴展你的村莊。每個牌組都有主題，例如烹飪、農業或是建造。
 
 在每個月底你會需要餵飽所有村民－確保食物充足，否則你的村民會餓死的哦！
 
   特色  🔥
   🃏 200+張卡牌可供蒐集
   💡 60+點子可供尋找
   ✅ 80+任務可完成
   📦 13個不同的牌組可購買
   🕒 5-7小時遊戲時間  
   戰鬥   🗡️
 村民遇到邪惡的生物會進入自動戰鬥。打敗哥布林、熊、跟老鼠還有其他生物吧！可以給予武器來增進村民的戰鬥能力，或是讓他們組隊對抗敵人。
 
  
 
   找尋點子   🧠
 尋找「點子卡牌」來拓展知識。點子卡牌會告訴你如何創造新的卡牌，舉例來說：堆疊2張「木材」、1張「石頭」以及1張「村民」就能建造房子。

Stacklands   es un juego de construcción de aldeas en el que tendrás que apilar cartas para conseguir comida, levantar estructuras y luchar contra criaturas.
 
 Por ejemplo, si colocas una carta de "Aldeano" sobre una de "Arbusto de bayas", se crearán cartas de "Baya" que podrán comer los aldeanos para sobrevivir.
 
  
 
   Vende cartas   💰
 También puedes vender cartas para conseguir monedas con las que comprar paquetes de cartas. Los paquetes contienen varias cartas que puedes usar para expandir tu aldea. Los paquetes se centran en recetas, granja o construcción.
 
 Al final de cada luna tendrás que alimentar a tus aldeanos, así que intenta conseguir suficiente comida, ¡o se morirán de hambre! 💀
 
   Características   🔥
   🃏 Más de 200 cartas que coleccionar
   💡 Más de 60 ideas que encontrar
   ✅ Más de 80 misiones que completar
   📦 13 paquetes de cartas diferentes que comprar
   🕒 De 5 a 7 horas de juego  
   Combate   🗡️
 Si un aldeano se encuentra con una criatura enemiga, comenzará el combate. ¡Lucha contra goblins, osos, ratas y mucho más! Mejora las habilidades de combate de tus aldeanos dándoles armas o forma equipos para luchar contra enemigos.
 
  
 
   Encuentra ideas   🧠
 Expande tu conocimiento encontrando cartas de ideas. Estas cartas te informan de cómo crear cartas nuevas. Por ejemplo: apila 2 de madera, 1 de piedra y 1 aldeano para construir una casa.

Stacklands   est un jeu de construction de village dans lequel vous devez empiler des cartes pour récolter de la nourriture, construire des bâtiments et combattre des créatures.
 
 Par exemple, si vous déposez une carte Villageois sur une carte Buisson, vous obtiendrez des cartes Baies que les Villageois pourront manger pour survivre !
 
  
 
   Vendre des cartes   💰
 Vous pouvez également vendre des cartes pour obtenir des pièces que vous pourrez dépenser pour acheter des packs. Les packs contiennent plusieurs cartes que vous pourrez utiliser pour développer votre village. Chaque pack se concentre sur un thème : Cuisine, Récolte ou Construction.
 
 À la fin de chaque Lune, vous devez nourrir vos Villageois. Assurez-vous d'avoir suffisamment de nourriture ou ils mourront de faim ! 💀
 
   Caractéristiques   🔥
   🃏 +200 cartes à collectionner
   💡 +60 Idées à trouver
   ✅ +80 Quêtes à accomplir
   📦 13 packs différents à acheter
   🕒 5-7 heures de jeu  
   Combat   🗡️
 Un Villageois qui rencontre une créature maléfique va automatiquement engager le combat. Affrontez des gobelins, des ours, des rats et plein d'autres créatures ! Améliorez les compétences de combat de vos Villageois en leur donnant des armes ou en les incitant à faire équipe pour repousser les dangers.
 
  
 
   Découvrir des Idées   🧠
 Élargissez vos connaissances en découvrant des cartes Idées. Une carte Idée peut vous indiquer comment créer de nouvelles cartes. Ainsi, si vous empilez 2 cartes Bois, 1 carte Pierre et 1 Villageois, vous pouvez construire une Maison.

Stacklands   ist eine Dorfbau-Simulation, bei der du Karten stapelst, um Nahrung zu sammeln, Gebäude zu errichten und gegen Kreaturen zu kämpfen.
 
 Ziehst du zum Beispiel eine „Dorfbewohner“-Karte auf eine „Beerenstrauch“-Karte, erhältst du „Beeren“-Karten, die die Dorfbewohner essen können, um zu überleben!
 
  
 
   Karten verkaufen   💰
 Du kannst auch Karten verkaufen, um Münzen zu erhalten, mit deren Hilfe du Kartenpakete kaufen kannst. Pakete enthalten mehrere Karten, die du zum Ausbau deines Dorfes verwenden kannst. Jedes Paket konzentriert sich auf ein Thema, wie z. B. Kochen, Landwirtschaft oder Bauen.
 
 Am Ende eines jeden Mondes musst du alle deine Dorfbewohner ernähren. Also sorge dafür, dass du genug Nahrung hast, sonst verhungern deine Dorfbewohner! 💀
 
   Features   🔥
   🃏 Sammle über 200 Karten.
   💡 Finde über 60 Ideen.
   ✅ Erfülle über 80 Quests.
   📦 Kaufe 13 verschiedene Kartenpakete.
   🕒 5 – 7 Stunden Spielzeit  
   Kampf   🗡️
 Trifft ein Dorfbewohner auf eine böse Kreatur, beginnt automatisch ein Kampf. Bekämpfe Kobolde, Bären, Ratten und vieles mehr! Verbessere die kämpferischen Fähigkeiten deiner Dorfbewohner mit Waffen, oder indem du Gegner im Team bekämpfst.
 
  
 
   Ideen finden   🧠
 Erweitere dein Wissen, indem du Ideen-Karten findest. Eine Ideen-Karte sagt dir, wie du neue Karten erstellen kannst – z. B.: Stapele 2 Holz, 1 Stein und 1 Dorfbewohner, um ein Haus zu bauen.

スタックランド  は、カードを重ねて食料を集め、建造物を建て、クリーチャーと戦う村づくりゲーム。
 
 例えば、「村人」のカードを「ベリーの木」に重ねると、村人たちが生き残るのに必要な「ベリー」が採れるんだ！
 
  
 
   カードの売却   💰
 カードを売ってコインを入手し、そのコインでカードパックを購入することもできるぞ。パックには複数のカードが入っている。それを使って村を発展させていこう。パックには、料理、農業、建築など、それぞれの分野に特化したカードが入っている。
 
 月齢の終わりには、すべての村人を養う必要があるので、十分な食料の蓄えがあるか確認するんだ！💀

   🃏 200枚以上のカードを集めよう
   💡 60種類以上のアイデアを発見しよう
   ✅ 80種類以上のクエストを制覇するんだ
   📦 13種類のカードパックを購入しよう
   🕒 5-7時間程のプレイ時間  
   戦闘   🗡️
 村人が邪悪な生き物に遭遇すると、自動的に戦闘になる。ゴブリン、クマ、ネズミなど、様々な生物と戦おう。武器を持たせたり、チームを組ませたりして、村人の戦闘能力をアップさせよう。
 
  
 
   アイデアを発見しよう   🧠
 アイデアカードを見つけることで、知識を深めることができる。例えば、「材木」を2枚、「石」を1枚、「村人」を1枚を重ねて「家」を建てるなど、「アイデアカード」には新しいカードの作り方が書かれている。

 Erweitere dein Wissen, indem du Ideen-Karten findest. Eine Ideen-Karte sagt dir, wie du neue Karten erstellen kannst – z. B.: Stapele 2 Holz, 1 Stein und 1 Dorfbewohner, um ein Haus zu bauen.

title: The Witness
description:
The Witness is a single-player game in an open world with dozens of locations to explore and over 500 puzzles. This game respects you as an intelligent player and it treats your time as precious. There's no filler; each of those puzzles brings its own new idea into the mix. So, this is a game full of ideas.

You wake up, alone, on a strange island full of puzzles that will challenge and surprise you.

You don't remember who you are, and you don't remember how you got here, but there's one thing you can do: explore the island in hope of discovering clues, regaining your memory, and somehow finding your way home.

title: Assassin's Creed Unity
description:
A RUTHLESS NEW HERO FOR A BRUTAL NEW WORLD  
Play as Arno, an entirely new breed of Assassin more lethal than his ancestors. Take down your prey with a range of new weapons such as the Phantom Blade, a Hidden Blade with crossbow capabilities.
        
  EXPERIENCE SEAMLESS PARKOUR, COMBAT, AND STEALTH GAMEPLAY  
Enjoy a high degree of freedom and control over your Assassin, with parkour mechanics for seamless free running, a revamped fighting system, and enhanced stealth gameplay.
        
  DISCOVER REVOLUTIONARY PARIS  
The French Revolution turns a once magnificent city into a place of terror and chaos. Explore the stunning, full-scale open world city and witness history unfold. Experience key events, from the storming of the Bastille to the execution of King Louis XVI, as France's fate is shaped in the streets of a city on the edge of transformation.

localized_description.text:

Play as Arno, an entirely new breed of Assassin more lethal than his ancestors. Take down your prey with a range of new weapons such as the Phantom Blade, a Hidden Blade with crossbow capabilities.
        
  EXPERIENCE SEAMLESS PARKOUR, COMBAT, AND STEALTH GAMEPLAY  
Enjoy a high degree of freedom and control over your Assassin, with parkour mechanics for seamless free running, a revamped fighting system, and enhanced stealth gameplay.
        
  DISCOVER REVOLUTIONARY PARIS  
The French Revolution turns a once magnificent city into a place of terror and chaos. Explore the stunning, full-scale open world city and witness history unfold. Experience key events, from the storming of the Bastille to the execution of King Louis XVI, as France's fate is shaped in the streets of a city on the edge of transformation.

UN HÉROE DESPIADADO PARA UN MUNDO BRUTAL  
Ponte en la piel de Arno, una nueva clase de asesino mucho más letal que sus antepasados. Elimina a tu presa con una variedad de armas nuevas, como la Hoja fantasma, una hoja oculta que puede usarse como ballesta.
        
  DISFRUTA DE MECÁNICAS DE PARKOUR, COMBATE Y SIGILO FLUIDAS  
Controla con total libertad a tu asesino con una mecánica de parkour que permite correr libremente con fluidez, un sistema de combate renovado y una mecánica de sigilo mejorada.
        
  DESCUBRE EL PARÍS REVOLUCIONARIO  
La Revolución Francesa ha convertido una ciudad, antaño majestuosa, en un lugar de terror y caos. Explora esta fabulosa ciudad de mundo abierto a escala real y sé testigo de cómo se desarrolla la historia. Vive momentos históricos clave, desde la toma de la Bastilla hasta la ejecución del rey Luis XVI, mientras el destino de Francia se decide en las calles de una ciudad que está experimentando una profunda transformación.

UN NOUVEAU HÉROS SANS PITIÉ POUR UN MONDE SANS MERCI  
Incarnez Arno, un nouveau genre d'Assassins, plus mortel que ses prédécesseurs. Terrassez vos proies avec un arsenal d'armes inédites comme la Lame fantôme, une lame secrète avec une arbalète intégrée.
        
  UN GAMEPLAY FLUIDE MÊLANT PARKOUR, COMBAT ET INFILTRATION  
Profitez d'une grande liberté et d'un contrôle total sur votre Assassin, avec des mécaniques de parkour fluides, un système de combat repensé et un gameplay de furtivité amélioré.
        
  DÉCOUVREZ LE PARIS RÉVOLUTIONNAIRE  
La Révolution française transforme une ville autrefois magnifique en un lieu de terreur et de chaos. Explorez une ville en monde ouvert à échelle 1:1 et regardez l'Histoire se dérouler sous vos yeux. Revivez les événements clés, de la prise de la Bastille à l'exécution du roi Louis XVI, alors que le destin de la France se joue dans les rues d'une ville en pleine transformation.

EIN SKRUPELLOSER NEUER HELD FÜR EINE BRUTALE NEUE WELT  
Spiele als Arno, ein völlig neuer Assassine, der noch tödlicher als seine Vorfahren ist. Erlege deine Beute mit einer Auswahl neuer Waffen wie der Phantomklinge, einer Versteckten Klinge mit eingebauter Armbrust.
        
  ERLEBE NAHTLOSES GAMEPLAY MIT PARKOUR, KAMPF UND SCHLEICHEN  
Genieße ein hohes Maß an Freiheit und Kontrolle über deinen Assassinen, mit Parkour-Mechaniken für nahtloses Free-Running, einem überarbeiteten Kampfsystem und verbessertem Schleichen.
        
  ENTDECKE PARIS WÄHREND DER REVOLUTION  
Die Französische Revolution verwandelt eine einst prachtvolle Stadt in einen Ort des Terrors und der Zerstörung. Erkunde die atemberaubende, originalgetreue Open-World-Stadt und erlebe, wie Geschichte geschrieben wird. Erlebe wichtige historische Ereignisse, vom Sturm auf die Bastille bis zur Hinrichtung von König Ludwig XVI., während das Schicksal Frankreichs auf den Straßen einer sich verwandelnden Stadt seinen Lauf nimmt.

UM NOVO HERÓI IMPLACÁVEL PARA UM NOVO MUNDO BRUTAL  
Jogue como Arno, um tipo de assassino totalmente novo, mais letal que seus antecessores. Cace suas presas com uma gama de novas armas, tais como a Lâmina Fantasma, uma Lâmina Oculta com a capacidade de disparar como uma besta.
        
  EXPERIMENTE A JOGABILIDADE FLUIDA EM PARKOUR, COMBATE E FURTIVIDADE  
Desfrute de um alto grau de liberdade e controle sobre seu assassino, com mecânicas de parkour que possibilitam movimentos livres e fluídos, um sistema de combate reformulado e jogabilidade de furtividade aprimorada.
        
  DESCUBRA A PARIS REVOLUCIONÁRIA  
A Revolução Francesa transformou uma cidade magnífica em um ambiente de terror e caos. Explore essa cidade impressionante como um mundo aberto em larga escala e testemunhe o desenrolar dos eventos históricos. Viva eventos importantes, desde a tomada da Bastilha à execução do Rei Luís XVI, conforme o destino da França é decidido nas ruas de uma cidade à beira da transformação.

EN NÅDESLØS NY HELT TIL EN BRUTAL NY VERDEN  
Spil som Arno: En helt ny type snigmorder, der er endnu mere dødbringende end hans forgængere. Nedlæg dit bytte med nye våben, som for eksempel dit Phantom Blade, der er en skjult klinge med armbrøstfunktionalitet.
        
  OPLEV FLYDENDE PARKOUR, KAMP OG SNIGEGAMEPLAY  
Oplev stor frihed og kontrol over din snigmorder med parkourmekanik, der lader dig løbe helt frit og flydende rundt, et nyt kampsystem og forbedret snigegameplay.
        
  UDFORSK REVOLUTIONENS PARIS  
Den franske revolution omdanner en engang så storslået by til et sted fyldt med rædsel og kaos. Udforsk den utroligt flotte åbne by, og se historien udfolde sig. Oplev vigtige historiske begivenheder, lige fra angrebet på Bastillen til henrettelsen af kong Louis den 16., mens Frankrigs skæbne afgøres i gaderne i en by, der er på randen af den totale transformation.

UN NUOVO EROE SPIETATO PER UN NUOVO MONDO BRUTALE  
Gioca nei panni di Arno, un Assassino totalmente diverso e molto più letale di chiunque l'abbia preceduto. Colpisci i tuoi nemici usando armi inedite come la lama fantasma, un incrocio fra lama celata e balestra.
        
  LA PERFETTA INTEGRAZIONE TRA CORSA ACROBATICA, COMBATTIMENTO E FURTIVITÀ  
Sfrutta al massimo la libertà di movimento e controllo del tuo Assassino, con meccaniche di corsa acrobatica senza soluzione di continuità, un sistema di combattimento rinnovato e sequenze furtive migliorate.
        
  SCOPRI LA PARIGI RIVOLUZIONARIA  
La Rivoluzione francese ha gettato nel terrore e nel caos quella che era una magnifica città. Esplora una magnifica città a mondo aperto, fedele in ogni dettaglio, e vivi la storia in prima persona. Assisti a momenti chiave, come la presa della Bastiglia e l'esecuzione di re Luigi XVI, mentre il futuro della Francia si decide sulle strade di una città sull'orlo del cambiamento.

title: Left 4 Dead
description:
From Valve (the creators of Counter-Strike, Half-Life and more) comes Left 4 Dead, a co-op action horror game for the PC and Xbox 360 that casts up to four players in an epic struggle for survival against swarming zombie hordes and terrifying mutant monsters.

Set in the immediate aftermath of the zombie apocalypse, L4D's survival co-op mode lets you blast a path through the infected in four unique “movies,” guiding your survivors across the rooftops of an abandoned metropolis, through rural ghost towns and pitch-black forests in your quest to escape a devastated Ground Zero crawling with infected enemies. Each "movie" is comprised of five large maps, and can be played by one to four human players, with an emphasis on team-based strategy and objectives.

New technology dubbed "the AI Director" is used to generate a unique gameplay experience every time you play. The Director tailors the frequency and ferocity of the zombie attacks to your performance, putting you in the middle of a fast-paced, but not overwhelming, Hollywood horror movie.

Addictive single player, co-op, and multiplayer action gameplay from the makers of Counter-Strike and Half-Life Versus Mode lets you compete four-on-four with friends, playing as a human trying to get rescued, or as a zombie boss monster that will stop at nothing to destroy them.

title: Team Fortress 2
description:
One of the most popular online action games of all time, Team Fortress 2 delivers constant free updates—new game modes, maps, equipment and, most importantly, hats. Nine distinct classes provide a broad range of tactical abilities and personalities, and lend themselves to a variety of player skills.

The Gravel War - the main setting for Team Fortress 2. A woman, by some accounts, begins acquiring the world's largest supply of Australium. Radigan Conagher finishes building a Life Extender Machine for Blutarch Mann. Saxton Hale fights and captures the last surviving Yeti. Charles Darling absconds with the panthers to put them in his new animal dungeon.

Administrator, hearing the news of her takeover of Mann Co., orders her assistant Miss Pauling to reassemble the Mercs, recovering Soldier from Hollywood, Pyro from Frontier, and Demoman from his Badlands home. Saxton Hale is released from the Millhaven Ultra Prison for Dangerous Men, held there for burning down most of Charles Darling's zoo months earlier. The Classic mercenaries arrive at New Zealand with the TF2 Medic, killing Sniper, and capturing the others. TF2 Engineer has been maintaining the Life Extender Machines of an elderly woman in 19th century attire, resembling Helen, but extremely aged. The team escapes, killing three Classic mercenaries, but are overcome by blood-sucking robots.

"Der größte Spaß, den Sie online erleben"  - PC Gamer
  
    Ab sofort KOSTENLOS!

    Das bestbewertete kostenlose Spiel aller Zeiten! 
  
   Als eines der beliebtesten Online-Actionspiele aller Zeiten liefert Team Fortress 2 regelmäßige, kostenlose Updates mit neuen Spielmodi, Karten, Ausrüstungen und vor allem Hüten. Neun verschiedene Klassen bieten eine breite Palette von taktischen Fähigkeiten und Persönlichkeiten, wodurch sie für verschiedenste Spielertypen geeignet sind. 
    Neu bei TF? Macht nichts! 
  
   Egal welchen Stil Sie bevorzugen oder wie erfahren Sie sind: Wir haben einen passenden Charakter für Sie. Ausführliches Training und Offline-Übungen werden Ihnen helfen, Ihre Fertigkeiten zu verbessern, bevor Sie sich in einen der zahlreichen Spielmodi von TF2 wagen, wie etwa Flaggeneroberung, Kontrollpunkte, Frachtbeförderung, Arena, King of the Hill und mehr.
    Erstellen Sie Ihren eigenen Charakter! 
  
   Es gibt hunderte Waffen, Hüte und mehr zum Sammeln, Herstellen und Handeln. Passen Sie Ihre Lieblingsklasse Ihrer Spielweise und Ihrem persönlichen Geschmack an. Sie müssen nicht bezahlen, um zu gewinnen — So gut wie alle Gegenstände aus dem Mann Co. Store können auch während des Spiels gefunden werden.

title: Portal 2
description: Sequel to the acclaimed Portal (2007), Portal 2 pits the protagonist of the original game, Chell, and her new robot friend, Wheatley, against more puzzles conceived by GLaDOS, an A.I. with the sole purpose of testing the Portal Gun's mechanics and taking revenge on Chell for the events of Portal. As a result of several interactions and revelations, Chell once again pushes to escape Aperture Science Labs.

localized_description.text: Sequel to the acclaimed Portal (2007), Portal 2 pits the protagonist of the original game, Chell, and her new robot friend, Wheatley, against more puzzles conceived by GLaDOS, an A.I. with the sole purpose of testing the Portal Gun's mechanics and taking revenge on Chell for the events of Portal. As a result of several interactions and revelations, Chell once again pushes to escape Aperture Science Labs.

Portal 2 draws from the award-winning formula of innovative gameplay, story, and music that earned the original Portal over 70 industry accolades and created a cult following.
 
 										The single-player portion of Portal 2 introduces a cast of dynamic new characters, a host of fresh puzzle elements, and a much larger set of devious test chambers. Players will explore never-before-seen areas of the Aperture Science Labs and be reunited with GLaDOS, the occasionally murderous computer companion who guided them through the original game.
 										
 										The game’s two-player cooperative mode features its own entirely separate campaign with a unique story, test chambers, and two new player characters. This new mode forces players to reconsider everything they thought they knew about portals. Success will require them to not just act cooperatively, but to think cooperatively.
 										
 										 Product Features 
 										   Extensive single player:  Featuring next generation gameplay and a wildly-engrossing story.
 										   Complete two-person co-op:  Multiplayer game featuring its own dedicated story, characters, and gameplay.
 										   Advanced physics:  Allows for the creation of a whole new range of interesting challenges, producing a much larger but not harder game.
 										   Original music. 
 										   Massive sequel:  The original Portal was named 2007's Game of the Year by over 30 publications worldwide. 
 										   Editing Tools:  Portal 2 editing tools will be included.

Portal 2 continúa con esa fórmula ganadora consistente en una innovadora mecánica de juego, historia y música que condujeron al Portal original a ganar más de 70 galardones y lo convirtieron en un nuevo mito de la industria.
 
 										En el modo de un jugador de Portal 2 conoceremos a un nuevo elenco de personajes, gran cantidad de innovadores puzles y un número mucho mayor de enrevesadas salas de pruebas. Los jugadores podrán explorar zonas de Aperture Science Labs nunca vistas anteriormente y volverán a encontrarse a GLaDOS, ese compañero computerizado, y en ocasiones con tendencias asesinas, que los guio a lo largo del juego original.
 										
 										El modo cooperativo para dos jugadores tiene su propia campaña totalmente independiente, con una historia única, salas de pruebas y dos nuevos personajes con los que podremos jugar. Este nuevo modo obliga a los jugadores a reconsiderar todo lo que creían saber acerca de los portales. Para tener éxito no solo deberán trabajar codo con codo, sino que también tendrán que pensar de forma cooperativa.
 										
 										 Características principales 
 										   Amplio modo de un jugador:  Con una mecánica de juego de nueva generación y una historia increíblemente fascinante.
 										   Cooperativo para dos jugadores:  El modo multijugador dispone de su propia historia, personajes y mecánica de juego.
 										   Física avanzada:  Permite la creación de nuevos e interesantes desafíos para disfrutar de un juego mucho más largo pero no más difícil.
 										   Música original. 
 										   Una gran secuela:  El Portal original fue elegido «Juego del Año 2007» por más de 30 publicaciones de todo el mundo. 
 										   Herramientas de edición:  Se incluirán las herramientas de edición para Portal 2.

Portal 2 nous vient tout droit du jeu original et culte Portal, primé à plus de 70 reprises pour sa jouabilité, son scénario et sa musique.
 
 La partie solo de Portal 2 présente un ensemble de nouveaux personnages, de nouveaux éléments de casse-têtes et de nouvelles chambres de test plus vastes. Parcourez des pans inconnus des laboratoires d'Aperture Science et retrouvez GLaDOS, l'ordinateur maléfique du jeu original.
 
 Le mode coopératif à deux comprend une campagne autonome avec sa propre histoire, des chambres de test inédites et deux nouveaux personnages. Ce nouveau mode va remettre en question vos connaissances des portails. Non seulement vous devrez agir à deux, mais vous devrez aussi penser à deux.
 
  Caractéristiques du jeu 
    Mode solo :  une jouabilité nouvelle génération et une histoire captivante.
    Mode coopératif à deux :  un mode multijoueur avec sa propre histoire, deux nouveaux personnages et une nouvelle jouabilité.
    Modèles physiques avancés :  les nouveaux modèles permettent la création de nouvelles épreuves dans un environnement plus vaste et plus complexe.
    Bande-son originale. 
    Suite d'un jeu incontournable :  le jeu Portal original a été primé meilleur jeu de l'année 2007 par plus de 30 parutions dans le monde entier.
    Outils d'édition :  des outils pour créer vos propres chambres de test sont inclus.

Portal 2 verfeinert die preisgekrönte Mischung aus innovativem Spielgeschehen, Story und Musik, die dem Originalspiel Portal über 70 Auszeichnungen eingebracht hat und einen wahren Kult auslöste.
 
 										Der Einzelspielermodus von Portal 2 präsentiert einige neue und dynamische Charaktere, mehrere neue Puzzle-Elemente und eine Vielzahl neuer hinterhältiger Testkammern. Die Spieler erkunden bislang unbekannte Bereiche der Aperture Science Laboratorien, natürlich wieder mit der bisweilen mörderischen Hilfe von GLaDOS, dem Computerbegleiter aus dem Originalspiel.
 										
 										Der Zwei-Spieler-Koop-Modus bietet zudem eine vollkommen separate Kampagne mit einer einzigartigen Geschichte, weiteren Testkammern und zwei neuen Spielcharakteren. Dieser neue Modus zwingt Spieler dazu, alles zu überdenken, was sie bezüglich Portalen zu wissen glaubten. Erfolg setzt nicht nur kooperative Aktionen voraus, sondern auch kooperatives Denken.
 										
 										 Produkteigenschaften 
 										   Umfangreicher Einzelspielermodus:  Spielgeschehen der nächsten Generation mit einer fesselnden Geschichte.
 										   Kompletter Zwei-Spieler-Koop-Modus:  Mehrspielermodus mit eigener Geschichte, Charakteren und Spielmechanik.
 										   Fortschrittliche Physik:  Vollkommen neue und interessante Herausforderungen in einem viel intensiveren Spiel, ohne dabei den Schwierigkeitsgrad zu heben.
 										   Originalmusik. 
 										   Großartige Fortsetzung:  Das Originalspiel wurde 2007 weltweit von über 30 Publikationen zum Spiel des Jahres gekürt. 
 										   Editor:  Portal-2-Editor enthalten.

O Portal 2 é baseado na premiada fórmula de jogabilidade, história e música inovadoras que garantiu ao Portal original mais de 70 prémios e criou um culto entre os fãs.
 
 										A porção de um jogador de Portal 2 introduz um elenco de novas personagens dinâmicas, novos elementos de puzzle e um conjunto muito maior de tortuosas câmaras de teste. Os jogadores irão explorar áreas nunca antes vistas dos Laboratórios da Aperture Science e serão reunidos com GLaDOS, o computador ocasionalmente homicida que os guiou através do jogo original.
 										
 										O modo cooperativo de dois jogadores apresenta a sua própria campanha com uma história e câmaras de teste únicas e duas novas personagens jogáveis. Este novo modo força os jogadores a pôr em causa tudo aquilo que pensavam saber acerca dos portais. O sucesso irá não só requerer que os jogadores ajam cooperativamente, mas também que pensem cooperativamente.
 										
 										 Características do produto 
 										   Modo de um jogador extensivo:  Com jogabilidade de próxima geração e uma história fascinante.
 										   Modo cooperativo completo para duas pessoas:  Modo multijogador com a sua própria história, personagens e jogabilidade dedicadas.
 										   Física avançada:  Permite a criação de todo um novo conjunto de interessantes desafios, produzindo um jogo muito maior, sem aumentar a sua dificuldade.
 										   Música original. 
 										   Sequela massiva:  O Portal original foi nomeado Jogo do Ano em 2007 por mais de 30 publicações em todo o mundo. 
 										    Ferramentas de edição:  As ferramentas de edição do Portal 2 estão incluídas.

Portal 2 følger den prisvindende opskrift med nyskabende spilindhold, handling og musik, som gjorde, at det originale Portal vandt over 70 priser og fik en dedikeret tilhængerskare.
 
 										Singleplayerdelen af Portal 2 introducerer en række nye dynamiske karakterer, en stribe nye puzzleelementer og et meget større sæt af lumske testkamre. Spillere udforsker hidtil usete områder i Aperture Science Labs og møder endnu en gang GLaDOS, den til tider morderiske computerfølgesvend, som guidede dem igennem det originale spil.
 										
 										Spillets co-op-tilstand for to spillere har sin helt egen separate kampagne med en unik handling, testkamre og to nye spillerkarakterer. Den nye tilstand tvinger spillere til at tage alt, hvad de ved om portaler, op til fornyet overvejelse. Deres succes er afhængig af, at de ikke blot arbejder sammen, men også tænker sammen.
 										
 										 Produktet indeholder: 
 										   Omfattende singleplayer:  Med næstegenerationsgameplay og opslugende handling.
 										   Co-op for to spillere:  Multiplayerspil med sin egen dedikerede handling, karakterbesætning og eget gameplay.
 										   Avanceret fysik:  Gør det muligt at skabe et helt nyt udvalg af spændende udfordringer, som gør spillet meget større, men ikke sværere.
 										   Original musik. 
 										   En gigantisk efterfølger:  Det originale Portal blev kåret som årets spil i 2007 af over 30 publikationer verden over. 
 										   Redigeringsværktøjer:  Redigeringsværktøjerne fra Portal 2 følger med.

Portal 2 attinge dalla premiata formula di innovativa giocabilità, storia e musica che è valsa al primo Portal oltre 70 premi di settore e che ha generato un culto.
 
 										La porzione da giocatore singolo di Portal 2 introduce un cast di nuovi e coinvolgenti personaggi, una serie di enigmi originali e un'ancora più lunga sfilza di tortuose camere di test. I giocatori esploreranno aree dei Laboratori di Aperture Science mai viste prima e si riuniranno a GLaDOS, il computer saltuariamente omicida che li guidò attraverso il primo gioco.
 										
 										La modalità cooperativa a due giocatori offre una campagna unica dotata di una trama completamente separata da quella originale, con nuove camere di test e due nuovi personaggi giocabili. Questa nuova modalità obbliga i giocatori a riconsiderare tutto ciò che credevano di conoscere riguardo i portali. Il successo richiederà sia di agire che di pensare cooperativamente.
 										
 										 Caratteristiche del prodotto 
 										   Ampia modalità a giocatore singolo:  con giocabilità di nuova generazione e storia ferocemente avvincente.
 										   Completa modalità cooperativa a due giocatori:  modalità multigiocatore dotata di storia, personaggi e giocabiltà originali.
 										   Sistema fisico avanzato:  permette la creazione di una nuova serie di sfide, rendendo il gioco più vasto ma non più difficile.
 										   Musica originale. 
 										   Grandioso seguito:  il primo Portal è stato nominato gioco dell'anno del 2007 da oltre 30 periodici in tutto il mondo. 
 										   Strumenti di editing:  Portal 2 includerà gli strumenti di editing.
